newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close at a new record high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close at a new record high.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed at a new record high on Wednesday amid a very high level of trading.
Both general index and Ibex 35 reached new peaks, with the first one rising 5.29 points, or 1.18 percent, to 452.86 and the other adding 59.94 points, or 1.16 percent to 5,221.50.
Blue chips as Repsol and Telefonica were attracting the biggest part of activity, dealers said.
Repsol rose 2.31 pct to 5,320 pesetas and Telefonica gained 110 pesetas to 3,280 pta.
In the banking sector BBV jumped 2.8 percent, while profit takings pushed down Banesto a 6.45 percent.
